newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.

text.p: COMEX nearby active copper futures were called to open slightly firmer Thursday, with LME copper marginally higher in London after the LME options declaration.

COMEX March copper was seen opening unchanged to up 0.20 cent from Tuesday's close 100.25 cents. COMEX was closed for the New Year holiday Wednesday and there was no after hours electronic ACCESS trade overnight.
COMEX warehouse copper stocks fell 1,032 short tons Tuesday to 29,487 short tons, after LME stocks rose 3,950 tonnes to 125,350 tonnes.
